title: Bounded chromatic number of graphs with small clique number and large minimum degree
summary: We prove that every triangle-free graph with minimum degree at least $\frac{n}{3}$ is $4$-colorable and thereby settle a problem of Brandt and Thomassé (2005) at the threshold $\frac{n}{3}$. The number four is best possible. For a positive integer-valued function $f(n)=o(n)$, we relate the chromatic number of $f(n)$-vertex subgraphs of the Kneser graph $KG(n,f(n))$ to that of triangle-free graphs with minimum degree at least $\frac{n}{3}-f(n)$.
